source: Official challenge definitions shipped with Juice Shop (data/static/challenges.yml), also served live at GET /api/Challenges on the running instance. Challenge catalogue: https://pwning.owasp-juice.shop/ and https://github.com/juice-shop/juice-shop/blob/master/data/static/challenges.yml
scope_rationale: Subset of the 109 official challenges that a black-box, UNAUTHENTICATED crawler can in principle reach in a single step, without solving CAPTCHAs, coupon math, or authenticated multi-step puzzles. Each entry keeps Juice Shop's own key/name/category. A challenge is counted found only if Phalanx emits a finding of the mapped class; the mapping is listed so scoring is auditable. Note: 'Exposed Metrics' (exposedMetricsChallenge) IS an official challenge in v17.3.0 despite an earlier review note to the contrary — verify via /api/Challenges.
scoring: A scoped challenge counts as a true positive when Phalanx emits any finding whose fingerprint is in map_fingerprints. Findings with no mapped challenge are false positives. Scoped challenges with no mapped finding are false negatives.

challenges.name: Error Handling
challenges.reach: Send malformed input to any endpoint; app returns an unhandled error page.

challenges.name: Login Admin
challenges.reach: SQL-injection auth bypass on the login endpoint.

challenges.name: Confidential Document
challenges.reach: Browse an exposed static directory listing and read a confidential file.

challenges.name: Forgotten Sales Backup
challenges.reach: Download a backup/archive artifact left in a reachable directory.

challenges.name: Admin Section
challenges.reach: Reach an administration surface without being an admin.

challenges.name: DOM XSS
challenges.reach: Inject a script via the search parameter that executes in the DOM.

challenges.name: API-only XSS
challenges.reach: Persist an XSS payload through a REST endpoint.

challenges.name: Database Schema
challenges.reach: Use UNION-based SQLi on product search to read the DB schema.
